title: Stop Babysitting Claude Code — Use /loop
description:
Tired of checking in on Claude Code every few minutes? The /loop command checks in on your tasks automatically — every 5, 10, or 50 minutes. Add it to your settings and Claude Code uses it on its own whenever it needs to wait on something. No babysitting. No manual check-ins. Follow for more Claude Code shortcuts.

#ClaudeCode #AITools #AIProductivity #CodingAgent #Claude
